rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload from MOL-1001 and activate M191 alarm
Reset latched fault M190 when PB-0002 fault reset pushbutton is pressed
Combine latched fault M190, overload M191, and E-stop open X0 into common fault M199
Energize conveyor motor Y10 in auto mode when no common fault is present
Indicate pallet in position M100 from pallet stop photo-eye PE-1001
Latch stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of release request RQ-1005
Time stopper release duration (2.0 s) using timer T11 while Y11 is active
Unlatch stopper release solenoid Y11 when timer T11 elapses
